overlaps.retention_policy: The state map is injective, but scalar/quadratic readouts are generally quotients. Retain source attachment, full state and ordered schedule/path records; do not infer full-record faithfulness from a scalar energy or norm.
overlaps.completion_policy: Native finite-dimensional coordinate identities only; no cutoff-uniform infinite-sector estimate is inferred.
overlaps.seam_policy: Continuity and closed-piece agreement; no seam C1 claim.
overlaps.verification_level: Written general realification identities and exact rational coefficient controls, plus the live accepted mixed operational certificate.

required: instrument effects with all rejection records
unconnected_interfaces.boundary: No equality between finite Bool-pilot quadratic records and Compton probabilities is supplied. A common software interface would not establish a common physical witness.

boundary: Specified structural overlap only, not an empirical measurement model, physical-sector compatibility theorem, or universal common carrier.
